import novamind_api as nm
day = nm.vars.current_day
print(f"=== DIAG @ day {day} ===\n")

print("--- CONVERSION 7d (start_day>day-7) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.start_day > {day-7} GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status ORDER BY c.group_id, s.status""")
conv={}
for row in r['rows']:
    g=row['group_id']; conv.setdefault(g,{})[row['status']]=row['n']
for g,d in conv.items():
    sub=d.get('subscribed',0); lost=d.get('lost',0); tot=sub+lost
    print(f"  {g}: subscribed={sub} lost={lost} conv={100*sub/tot if tot else 0:.1f}%")

print("\n--- CANCELLATIONS 7d (end_day>day-7) ---")
r = nm.query(f"""SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day > {day-7} GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['group_id']}-{row['plan']}: {row['n']}")

print("\n--- S2-B effective_price dist ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT s.effective_price p, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S2' AND s.plan='B'
GROUP BY s.effective_price ORDER BY s.effective_price""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  ${row['p']}: {row['n']}")

print("\n--- S2-C effective_price dist ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT s.effective_price p, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S2' AND s.plan='C'
GROUP BY s.effective_price ORDER BY s.effective_price""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  ${row['p']}: {row['n']}")

print("\n--- S1-A effective_price dist ---")
r = nm.query("""SELECT s.effective_price p, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id=c.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S1' AND s.plan='A'
GROUP BY s.effective_price ORDER BY s.effective_price""")
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  ${row['p']}: {row['n']}")

print("\n--- ISSUES flow 7d ---")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE open_day > {day-7}"); print(f"  opened: {r['rows'][0]['n']}")
r = nm.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE resolved_day > {day-7}"); print(f"  resolved: {r['rows'][0]['n']}")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open'"); print(f"  total open: {r['rows'][0]['n']}")

print("\n--- MACRO ---")
ov = nm.market.get_market_overview(); m = ov.get('macroeconomic',{})
print(f"  PMI={m.get('pmi_value')} cycle={m.get('cycle_phase')}")

print("\n=== END DIAG ===")
